content.text: The insurance clause fully matches the preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a full vendor insurance clause that meets our preferred position on every material term: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional E&O of USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5M (appropriate given Vendor processes Customer Data as a hosting provider), and workers' compensation as required by law, each maintained at Vendor's expense for the term plus one year. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, insurer quality, notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. Vendor is the bound party throughout, so the clause runs in our favour and no redline is warranted.
